WITH female_clients AS (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        AVG(salary) AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        financial.clients c
    JOIN 
        financial.transactions t ON c.client_id = t.client_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY 
        c.client_id
),
oldest_female_client AS (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        MIN(birthdate) AS min_birthdate
    FROM 
        financial.clients
    WHERE 
        gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY 
        client_id
)
SELECT 
    fc.client_id AS account_number,
    fc.avg_salary,
    (SELECT MAX(avg_salary) FROM female_clients) - (SELECT MIN(avg_salary) FROM female_clients) AS gap
FROM 
    female_clients fc
JOIN 
    oldest_female_client ofc ON fc.client_id = ofc.client_id

SELECT 
    ((a.balance_date_2 - a.balance_date_1) / a.balance_date_1) * 100 AS increase_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        MIN(CASE WHEN l.approval_date <= '1993-07-05' THEN b.balance END) AS balance_date_1,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.approval_date BETWEEN '1993-03-22' AND '1998-12-27' THEN b.balance END) AS balance_date_2
    FROM 
        clients c
    JOIN 
        loans l ON c.client_id = l.client_id
    JOIN 
        balances b ON c.client_id = b.client_id
    WHERE 
        l.approval_date <= '1998-12-27'
    GROUP BY 
        c.client_id
) a
